findings.finding: Evidence creation is nested under a newly inserted proposition; actual link table is proposition_evidence, not proposed inspection name proposition_evidence_links.
Importer maps any unit type containing hadith to single_hadith_citation, otherwise single_named_attribution. This is code behavior, not proof of database allowed values.
Route insertion requires a truthy chain; an abbreviated citation with null/empty chain would produce no route row. The route description-only design is not supported by this importer.

decision: Do not run this importer for R02 citation-only staging: it would require a new proposition and would omit the null-chain route. Do not fabricate a chain to satisfy its branch.
remaining: Read-only inspect evidence_units and proposition_evidence constraints, then identify an authorized importer supporting separate citation evidence and nullable chains, or stage a bounded importer repair without publication.
